faq.a: On the City of Vancouver's own heritage-area description, Yaletown is bordered by Homer and Nelson streets to the north and east, and Cambie, Mainland, and Drake streets to the south and west, on the north shore of False Creek in downtown Vancouver.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Yaletown?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Yaletown?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Yaletown?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
